text: Retrieval finds the right five chunks. This lesson writes the instructions that turn them into an actual answer.
The system prompt tells GPT-4o to use the retrieved context to answer the question, state exact details like extensions and dollar amounts verbatim, and keep answers short.
Every question runs through one function: retrieve the context, then call Azure OpenAI's GPT-4o deployment with that context and the question.
Tested against thirty real questions pulled from past IT and HR tickets -- VPN setup, PTO, expense deadlines, dock procedures. Priya and Omar reviewed the transcripts and signed off.
Next: showing which document backs each answer, and a real 'I don't know' when nothing retrieved is good enough.
